v0.14.2 makes Git backup sync safer: a pull now applies all or nothing, and a force push is refused when it would drop commits on the remote. Damaged SQLite files no longer cost you real data, since only rebuildable indexes are deleted. Pages are easier to read: text, code and tables share one centered column. API keys (experimental) can now write, the install and update scripts verify the release checksum, and there are Linux 32-bit x86 binaries.

## 📝 Changelog for v0.14.0

PDFs now embed right in the page, LeafWiki speaks French and Simplified Chinese,
and admins can make the table of contents always visible. Most of the rest of
this release is hardening: how uploaded files are served, how sessions end after
a password change, and how search handles odd input.

### 🌟 Highlights

- **PDF embeds**: link a PDF and it renders inline in the page. Only same-origin
  PDFs are embedded; external ones and mobile get a file card with an open
  button.

Rebranded from hermes-proactive-agent to hermes-super-agent (super-agent) around the Lead–Worker Super Agent architecture, with upgraded bilingual documentation and backward-compatible PROACTIVE_* env fallback.

## proactive-agent 0.1.17

Recommended subagent step ceiling raised to 90, terminal background detach transitioned cleanly to Hermes' `tool_execution` middleware, and subagent / cron routing decoupled from private internal modules.

- **Recommended subagent iteration ceiling raised to 90.** The recommended `delegation.max_iterations` host configuration is now 90 (up from 60), accommodating complex multi-step worker tasks without prematurely cutting off iterative execution.

## proactive-agent 0.1.16

Two gaps closed: a subagent result no longer gets lost when you write just as it arrives, and a subagent that needs a decision now brings the question back instead of guessing.

- **A result reaches you even if you interrupt it.** When a background subagent finishes and you send a message while the main agent is reporting, the main agent used to answer only your message. Now the result stays marked unreported until a reply you did not cut into. The next tool result reminds the mai

## proactive-agent 0.1.15

The plugin now talks only to the main agent, the turn budget uses Hermes' real tool names, and the code and docs are reorganised around the four things the plugin promises.

- **Nothing goes to your chat directly.** A worker stopped for repeating itself is now reported to the main agent only. Its next turn opens with the note and it tells you in one line what got stuck and what it will do instead. The plugin itself no longer posts any message.
- **Turn budget uses Hermes' register

- **Task ledger.** One record per delegated task: goal, status, files it changed, corrections sent with `action='steer'`, its live transcript path, and how it ended (summary, evidence, blockers). Written by the plugin's hooks only, with no model calls, in `<hermes home>/plugin-data/proactive-agent/ledger.db`. Each chat keeps its last 20 finished tasks for up to 7 days.

## proactive-agent 0.1.13

Layout release: no behaviour changes.

- **The plugin has its own directory.** `plugin.yaml` and all modules live in `proactive-agent/`. Hermes installs only that directory, so tests and docs no longer land in `~/.hermes/plugins/`.
- **New install command.** The old README command with a `github:` prefix never worked (Hermes does not accept that prefix). Use:

```bash
hermes plugins install JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/proactive-agent
hermes plugins enable proactive-agent
``

## proactive-agent 0.1.12

Housekeeping release: no behaviour changes.

- **Manifest:** `plugin.yaml` declares `requires_hermes: ">=0.22"`, `license`, `homepage` and `tags`, and lists hooks only under the canonical `provides_hooks`.
- **Tooling:** `pyproject.toml` carries real metadata and a `dev` dependency group (`uv run --group dev pytest` or `pip install --group dev`); one `.flake8` config for local runs and CI.
- **CI:** Python 3.10 to 3.14.
- **Tests:** one test file per module, with shared helpers.

Trims the lean prototype further.

- **Full memory for workers:** `USER.md` and `MEMORY.md` are attached to every handoff in full (Hermes already caps both files).
- **Step budget left to Hermes:** the plugin no longer has its own step budget. Use `delegation.max_iterations`; when it runs out, Hermes gives the worker one last call to write its report. Recommended: `delegation.max_iterations: 60`.

## proactive-agent 0.1.10

A lean prototype of the secretary/worker design. Each stage of a task does one simple thing, and safety checks Hermes already does are left to Hermes.

### What it does
- **Turn budget (main agent):** a reminder at 60 s; from 120 s editing and execution tools pause, while read-only tools and `delegate_task` stay. A message from you mid-turn resets it. Commands longer than 30 s move to the background; `process_manage(wait)` is refused.
- **Handoff:** a `delegate_task` brief under 1

## proactive-agent 0.1.9

A secretary-style governor for Hermes chat agents. The main agent ("secretary") stays responsive and does the thinking; delegated subagents ("workers") do slow execution with a complete brief and under supervision.

### Main agent turn budget
- Yellow at 60 s or 30,000 chars of tool output: one reminder to answer or delegate within 1-2 steps.
- Red at 120 s or 80,000 chars: editing and execution tools are refused; read-only tools and `delegate_task` remain.
